title: STARTEX — Cyclone Tevra, Eight Hours After Landfall

fields.location: Harbourlight Relief International country office, Beira, Sofala Province, Mozambique
fields.weather: Overcast, heavy rain bands easing; gusts 60–70 km/h
fields.load: Sudden-onset emergency: GDACS RED alert for Mozambique; INGD Sofala Boletim n.º 1 (05:30) confirms landfall and widespread flooding
fields.staffing: Skeleton crew of 9 staff on site at the Beira office; 61 of 64 staff accounted for
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. Tropical Cyclone Tevra made landfall near Beira at about 22:00 last night, Wednesday 11 November, with winds near 190 km/h and a storm surge along the coast. It is now 06:00 Central Africa Time on Thursday 12 November 2026, eight hours after landfall, and you are at the HRI country office in Beira. Mains power is off across the city and the office is on its generator, and INGD's 05:30 bulletin reports widespread flooding and the EN6 crossing at Dondo cut. On the 05:55 roll call board, 61 of 64 staff are accounted for. Three members of the Buzi WASH team, a WASH officer, a driver and a community mobiliser, last checked in by radio from Buzi district at 19:40 last night, and there has been no radio, phone or WhatsApp contact with them since.

status.name: Staff accountability
status.note: 61 of 64 accounted for at 05:55. Buzi WASH team (WASH officer, driver, community mobiliser) silent since 19:40 Wed 11 Nov. Dependants not yet contacted.

status.name: Road access
status.note: EN6 crossing at Dondo cut (INGD Boletim n.º 1, 05:30). No confirmed road route to Buzi district.

status.name: Communications
status.note: Mobile data comes and goes. HF radio works to Beira and Dondo. No link to Buzi.

status.name: Beira office and power
status.note: City mains off; office running on generator. No injuries reported in Beira.

status.name: Vehicles
status.note: All Beira vehicles parked in the compound.

fields.facilitatorNote: Read the narration, then display the status board. Do not volunteer anything about the warehouse or Buzi beyond what is on this card; answer player questions with 'unknown at this time'.
fields.scenarioTitle: Wet Stock — Cyclone Response, Coordination & Pipeline Integrity

instructorNote: This card opens play. Watch for the Country Director to activate the emergency response plan and start the 0–6 hour actions in Plan section 4: contact every staff member and their dependants, check the office and vehicles, notify HQ and check warehouse stock. The Security Focal Point should treat the silence from Buzi as a new threat sign under HMSSSP section 3. That means stopping movements to Buzi and sharing an alert with the UN security officer and the NGO safety network straight away, before the facts are confirmed.
